Subject: Coordinating rotating demo windows across US / EU / APAC — next steps & concierge slots

Hi Lisa — thanks again for taking time earlier today. Quick recap and a concrete proposal to lock the next session (technical deep dive / demo):

Recap (short)
- Goals: validate inference throughput on 5k daily requests, confirm routing/fallback behavior, and discuss SSO/KMS integration timeline.
- Attendees you mentioned: yourself, Samir (engineering), and an infra lead (TBD).
- Success criteria: demo shows sub-200ms p95 for 1k token payload in a dedicated pool + clear rollout steps.

Proposed approach
- To make scheduling easier across your US/EU/APAC stakeholders, we suggest a 3-week rotating demo window. Each week the primary demo window favors one region, but times are adjusted so key participants in other regions can attend.

Concierge sample slots (pick one column):
1) Week A — APAC-focused (best for Samir):
   - 09:00 SGT / 02:00 BST / 21:00 PDT (previous day) — duration 60m
2) Week B — EU-focused:
   - 13:00 BST / 05:00 PDT / 20:00 SGT — duration 60m
3) Week C — US-focused:
   - 10:30 PDT / 18:30 BST / 01:30 SGT (next day) — duration 60m

We can run the rotation starting the week of Sep 8 so each subsequent demo favors a different timezone; that allows your APAC infra folks to join one of the early weeks while EU/US participants still get a fair slot.

Next steps (simple):
- Reply with preferred slot (Week A/B/C) and whether Samir and the infra lead can attend.
- I attached scoping-notes.pdf and a quick availability grid (demo-availability-grid.csv) so you can paste into your calendar.
- If you prefer, pick a time directly on my calendar: https://calendar.redwood.com/meet/ben/demo-ava-32458

Attaching: scoping-notes.pdf (1p), demo-availability-grid.csv

Thanks — we’ll lock the invite once you confirm.

— Tessa
Tessa Morgan | Enterprise SDR | Redwood Inference
